title: Alchemy docs.yml
description: Navigation configuration for the Alchemy docs site. Allows only the options supported by the content indexer (src/content-indexer/types/docsYaml.ts), including Alchemy-specific extensions (skip-slug, flattened, url-path, include-tags).

tabs.description: Top-level tabs shown in the docs header. Keys are tab identifiers referenced by navigation[].tab.

navigation.description: Sidebar navigation layout for each tab.

tab.description: Tab identifier; must match a key under tabs.

layout.description: Navigation items for this tab. Omit for tabs whose content is generated elsewhere (e.g. the changelog tab).

display-name.description: Human-readable tab label shown in the header.

slug.description: URL segment for the tab. Defaults to the kebab-cased tab key.

skip-slug.description: Alchemy extension: omit this tab's slug from descendant URL paths.

pageItem.description: A single docs page backed by an MDX file.

page.description: Page title shown in the sidebar.

path.description: Path to the page's .mdx file, relative to the content directory.

slug.description: URL segment for the page. Defaults to the kebab-cased page title. May contain slashes to override the full path.

hidden.description: Hide this page from the sidebar and search indexing.

sectionItem.description: A collapsible group of navigation items, optionally with an overview page.

section.description: Section title shown in the sidebar.

path.description: Optional overview page for the section: path to an .mdx file, relative to the content directory.

slug.description: URL segment for the section. Defaults to the kebab-cased section title.

skip-slug.description: Alchemy extension: omit this section's slug from descendant URL paths.

url-path.description: Alchemy extension: replace the inherited URL path for this section and its descendants. Do not include a /docs prefix.

hidden.description: Hide this section and its contents from the sidebar and search indexing.

linkItem.description: A sidebar entry linking to an internal path or external URL.

link.description: Link text shown in the sidebar.

href.description: Destination: an internal path (e.g. /docs/...) or an external URL.

apiItem.description: An auto-generated API reference section backed by an uploaded API spec.

api.description: Title for the API reference section.

api-name.description: Identifier of the API spec to render (must match an uploaded spec name).

slug.description: URL segment for the API section. Defaults to the kebab-cased title.

skip-slug.description: Alchemy extension: omit this section's slug from endpoint URL paths.

hidden.description: Hide the endpoints from the sidebar and search indexing.

flattened.description: Alchemy extension: render endpoints as a flat list instead of grouped by spec hierarchy.

include-tags.description: Alchemy extension: keep only OpenAPI operations whose first tag is in this list.
